name: Checkbox
description: A standard checkbox component allowing users to select one or more options. Supports checked, unchecked, and indeterminate states.
usage: Use for boolean selections or when multiple items can be chosen from a list.
Bind the `checked` prop to a state variable (boolean or 'indeterminate').
Use the `onChange` callback to update the state.

The `indeterminate` state visually indicates that a sub-selection is partially checked (e.g., in a tree structure). You must manage the transition out of the indeterminate state logically (e.g., clicking it might turn it fully checked).
examples:
```tsx
// Disabled Checkbox
<Checkbox id="disabled-check" checked={true} onChange={() => {}} label="Cannot change" disabled />
```

```tsx
// Indeterminate Checkbox
<Checkbox id="select-all" checked={'indeterminate'} onChange={handleSelectAllChange} label="Select some items" />
```

```tsx
// Different Sizes
<Checkbox id="small-check" checked={val} onChange={setVal} label="Small" size="sm" />
<Checkbox id="medium-check" checked={val} onChange={setVal} label="Medium" size="md" />
<Checkbox id="large-check" checked={val} onChange={setVal} label="Large" size="lg" />
```
design: Use checkboxes for lists where users can select zero, one, or multiple items.
Use the indeterminate state primarily for parent checkboxes that reflect the state of child checkboxes.
accessibility: Uses a visually hidden native `<input type="checkbox">` for semantics and keyboard navigation.
Focus states are handled with `peer-focus-visible` styles on the custom visual element.
The `label` prop is associated with the input via the `htmlFor` attribute.
The custom visual element uses `aria-hidden="true"` as the native input provides the semantics.

props.name: id
props.description: Unique identifier for the input element.

props.name: checked
props.description: The state of the checkbox: true (checked), false (unchecked), or 'indeterminate'.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback function invoked when the checkbox state changes. Receives the new boolean state (true/false). Note: indeterminate state change triggers with 'false' if clicked.

props.name: label
props.description: The content to display next to the checkbox, typically a string or JSX.

props.name: disabled
props.description: If true, the checkbox will be visually disabled and non-interactive.

props.name: size
props.description: Specifies the size of the checkbox visual element.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes to apply to the root label element.
